text_block_list.text:
I went looking for Tazuna-san to ask her 
out somewhere, and then—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
――Like I said, we have to deal with this 
immediately!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I-Incoming, already?! Tazuna, whoa, too 
close, your face is way too close...!!

An uncharacteristically rough tone of 
voice could be heard echoing from around 
the corner.

When I went to go check on the 
situation...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Pardon the intrusion! However, 
Chairwoman Akikawa, we have a grave 
situation on our hands!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy's infirmary is the vital 
lifeline for the Umamusume――

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
We must always have fully stocked 
facilities. Running out of medical 
supplies is completely out of the 
question!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Naturally! I understand that well.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
However, an accident in transit cannot be 
helped! Naturally, we shall contact the 
client right away and prepare a 
replacement shipmentââ

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Still, if we do that, we won't make it in 
time for today!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: CALMNESS!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Calm down, Tazuna. Even if deliveries 
are slightly delayed, we have reserves.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
If you are this flustered, it will spread 
anxiety to the students. Go cool your 
head.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I... I am sorry. I will do as you say...

Watching Tazuna-san trudge off dejectedly, 
I hurried after her.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Ah... Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Did you happen to see what just 
happened earlier?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... How embarrassing. I lost my 
temper before I knew it.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...I have seen so many girls during my 
time here at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course, there were those who performed 
brilliantly in the Twinkle Series and 
moved on to the Dream Trophy afterwards, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Girls like that are only a tiny handful. 
...For most, it doesn't go nearly so well.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Because of injuries or accidents, there 
were many girls... who couldn't even run 
properly anymore.
choice_data_list:
So that's why she was trying so 
desperately……

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Given that they put their lives on the 
line to come here, most of these girls 
truly love running from the bottom of 
their hearts.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
And yet, never being able to feel the wind 
again... The despair of that moment is 
simply—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...Because it is truly formidable.

After saying that, Ms. Tazuna remained 
silent for a while.

From far off across the grounds, the 
sounds of someone training come echoing 
over...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! My head's totally cooled down 
now!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'd best be getting back to work. 
Sorry for making you worry! See you 
around—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Eep!?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: S-Sorry, my legs got tangled up. Ahaha...

Ms. Tazuna offered a smile, but looking 
closely, I noticed a scrape near her 
ankle.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? No, no, this is the least I could 
do...!

Brushing aside Ms. Tazuna's polite 
protests, I finished tending to her injury 
using the first-aid kit I carried.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you very much... You really are a 
natural when it comes to first aid, aren't 
you...
choice_data_list: Well, I am a Trainer after all.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I... suppose so...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
With you, Trainer... I can watch with 
complete peace of mind.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I might be just a tiny bit jealous of your 
trainee, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Just kidding. Only teasing♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...You've taken such wonderful care of me. 
If you don't mind, would you allow me to 
repay you?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Let's go grab a meal together again! It'll 
be my treat today~.

—And so, Tazuna-san and I headed to our 
usual ramen shop.
